title: How a Finance Company Increased Recovery Rates by 2.6x with Targeted Collections Strategy
summary: See how Concentrix helped a finance company improve recovery rates from 0.1% to 0.26% through segmentation, analytics, and a focused full-debt collection approach.
body_markdown:
A finance company managing a portfolio of overdue accounts aimed to improve its recovery rate (ROR) while maintaining profitability.


Traditional approaches often relied on interest and fee waiver programs to incentivize repayment, which impacted overall returns. At the same time, broad, non-targeted collection strategies led to inefficient engagement and low recovery performance.


The company needed a more focused and data-driven approach to identify the right customer segments and maximize recovery without over-reliance on financial concessions.
